text.answer: Jack in the Box becomes hidden after arming. Enemy contact triggers nearby fear, a brief root, and a slow; the box then fires magic damage at nearby visible enemies. Its attacks deal increased damage when focused on a single target. Revealing a hidden box makes it targetable and vulnerable while visible.
text.counterplay: Avoid chasing through prepared ground, and use trap reveal effects to expose hidden boxes for attacks.

text.answer: While Two-Shiv Poison is ready, Shaco's basic attacks slow enemies. Casting it throws a targeted dagger that deals magic damage and slows, with increased damage against low-health targets and extra magic damage from behind. Casting the dagger puts the passive attack slow on hold until the ability is ready again.
text.counterplay: Respect the dagger when low on health, and watch for its cast before trying to disengage from his attacks.

text.answer: Hallucinate briefly makes Shaco vanish and blink, creating a controllable clone that can attack. When the clone dies or expires, it explodes for nearby magic damage and deploys mini-boxes that activate immediately, fearing, rooting, and slowing nearby enemies before attacking them.
text.counterplay: Keep space from the clone as it nears death, and avoid standing near its explosion and boxes.
